label: Highly distressed, high-screen-time women with advanced education
summary: This profile is characterized by comparatively higher loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms. The demographic pattern centers on women with graduate-level or higher education who report more than 5 hours of screen time.
demographic_anchor: Female; graduate degree or above; more than 5 hours of screen time
behavior_markers: Associated with high daily screen time (more than 5 hours)

label: Low distress, low loneliness profile
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: Predominantly male, educated to graduate level or above, with typical reported use in the 1-3 hour range.
behavior_markers: Represents 150 respondents in the training split

label: Higher loneliness with comparatively lower depression and anxiety
summary: Respondents in this profile report relatively elevated loneliness while showing lower average depressive and anxiety symptoms. The pattern suggests a group that feels more socially disconnected than emotionally distressed on standard depression and anxiety measures.
demographic_anchor: Most characteristically represented by a female respondent with graduate-level education or above and 1-3 hours in the referenced duration category.
behavior_markers: Shows lower average depressive symptoms (PHQ-9 mean 0.86).
Shows lower average anxiety symptoms (GAD-7 mean 0.91).
Profile is defined by social disconnection more than by broad internalizing symptom severity.
tone: Socially disconnected but comparatively emotionally stable
